items.name: api-client
items.title: api / createApiClient + ApiError
items.description: Typed fetch wrapper with base URL, default headers, JSON serialisation, query-param injection, and an `ApiError` class with status/data populated from non-2xx responses. Drop-in for React Query / server actions.

items.name: query-keys
items.title: entityKeys + createQueryKeys
items.description: Factory for consistent React Query keys per entity. Each entity gets `.all` / `.lists()` / `.list(filters)` / `.details()` / `.detail(id)` so you can invalidate by scope. Pair with createQueryKeys(['invoices','contacts'] as const) for type-safe app-wide keys.

items.name: use-optimistic-mutation
items.title: useOptimisticMutation
items.description: React Query useMutation wrapper with optimistic update, automatic rollback on error, and success/error toast hooks. Pass queryKey + applyOptimistic to opt in to optimistic updates; pass invalidateKeys to refresh related list queries after the server confirms.

items.name: use-paginated-query
items.title: usePaginatedQuery
items.description: React Query abstraction over the framework's server-side pagination shape `{ data, total, page, pageSize, totalPages }`. Exposes setPage / nextPage / prevPage / hasNext / hasPrev. Uses keepPreviousData so tables don't blank on page change.

items.name: use-debounced-query
items.title: useDebouncedQuery
items.description: Search-style query with built-in input debounce. Returns the raw input (controlled) AND the debounced value used for the fetch. Composes with use-debounce; cancels stale requests via React Query.

items.name: use-infinite-scroll
items.title: useInfiniteScroll
items.description: Wires a React Query infinite query to an IntersectionObserver sentinel. Drop the returned ref on a bottom-of-list element and the hook calls fetchNextPage as it scrolls into view (respecting hasNextPage + isFetchingNextPage).

items.name: cache-redis
items.title: cacheGet / cacheSet / withCache / invalidateCache / tag helpers
items.description: Upstash Redis cache wrappers. withCache(key, ttl, fn) handles the cache-or-fetch pattern; invalidateCache(...keysOrPatterns) supports `*` wildcards via SCAN; tagKey/invalidateTag give cheap mass-invalidation. Errors never break the request.

items.name: use-polling
items.title: usePolling + usePollingFn
items.description: Polling manager that pauses while the tab is hidden, refetches immediately on focus. usePolling invalidates a React Query key; usePollingFn runs a callback directly.

items.name: prefetch-on-hover
items.title: PrefetchOnHover + usePrefetchOnHover
items.description: Prefetch React Query data on hover / focus so the user lands on a warm cache. Component wrapper + hook variant; both throttle via a cooldown so 100 list rows don't fire 100 prefetches.
